description: Find the tool ACTION that does what you need, across 2.2 million actions read from MCP servers, APIs, CLIs, SDKs, models, robots and devices. Say the task in plain words ('refund a payment', 'move the robot arm home', 'what's on my calendar tomorrow'); meaning search + word search, fused and ranked by measured trust. Every result carries its label: verified and signed · official · checked: not enough evidence yet · found in code, not yet checked · demo or tutorial · failed its last check. Never invoke a 'failed' result; treat 'checked' and 'found in code' as review-first.

answer.description: Also return a written answer: the products that do it, each cited to its maker's own pages (default false)

intent.description: Deprecated: the old name of `kind` (kept so 0.10 callers work)

kind.description: With search: 'product' (which product does X), 'action' (the one operation to call) or 'model' (which AI model)

named.description: With search: products the task names (e.g. ['stripe']), so they lead

search.description: Optional: your own 3–10 word search phrase. Skips our understanding step — faster, and the same input always gives the same results

task.description: What you need done, in plain words

name: unfragile_find
